issue.title: Bob Refs ⌘0 Newest: browse references by capture date
issue.description: In the Bob Refs panel, ⌘0 toggles a Newest mode: every reference in a date-grouped timeline, newest capture first, still filterable by typing. bob also reports a capture timestamp that is complete, rename-safe, and accurate to the minute where the vault knows the time.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: RefsLibrary refresh must carry git_added_at forward — RefsLibrary.swift (~line 568) rebuilds the snapshot with `next.gitAddedDates = (snapshot?.gitAddedDates ?? [:]).filter{...}` and never copies `gitAddedAt`, so every plain refresh drops git instants and (because pathsNeedingGitDates now lists git-dated rows without an instant) re-triggers the -g lane; bob-cli-9d.3 must carry gitAddedAt through that filter in addition to switching runGitDatePass to RefsSnapshot.mergingGitDates.

RefsCore Newest landed in bob-mac-capture: RefRecord.addedAt (decodeIfPresent), RefItem.addedAt parsed once in RefItem.make, RefsSnapshot.gitAddedAt/git_added_at (decode-if-present), pathsNeedingGitDates refill, pure RefsSnapshot.mergingGitDates; RefsListOrder + RefsListing.order, RefsSectionKind.added(RefsAddedGroup), RefsRanker.listing(order:), RefsNewest.swift timeline/groups, Newest captions/why-here/shortTime, moveSection in Newest, refs-rank --newest, README Data/Sorting/Tuning. Verified: just portable-check green (1368 tests, 0 failures, incl. 39 new RefsNewestTests); Mac scratch copy bundle.sh + just typecheck-tests PASS (scratch deleted); time formatting identical on Mac and Linux; live bob -g piped into refs-rank --newest works (installed bob predates bob-added-at so UNDATED still has 3 rows and no added_at). Decisions honored: newest_persistence=reset (panel phase), no decisions record edited. Follow-up recorded for bob-cli-9d.3: carry gitAddedAt through RefsLibrary refresh.
